scope: Read-only authoritative-mainline configuration audit, no estimator or solver execution.
config_owner: pipeline.run defaults; CLI argument_default=SUPPRESS. No user-facing configuration dataclass.

mainline_defaults.normalization: positive mean pairwise impedance distance, separately in R and X
mainline_defaults.fixed_initial_family: all singleton leaves; plus selected disjoint RNJ boundary clades for hybrid

effective_core_defaults.bound_initialization: explicit pipeline bound 2; data-derived bounds only when low-level caller passes None
effective_core_defaults.source_support: low-level Source builders only; mainline fit/evaluator have no Source API

validation_selection.validation_generation: independent replicate default 1 via second _simulate_pool call; training default replicate 0
validation_selection.SE: std of per-time-block MAEs with ddof=1 divided by sqrt(block count); 4 contiguous blocks per scenario
validation_selection.threshold: minimum validation MAE + SE of minimizing path point
validation_selection.tie_break: minimum raw support count among eligible path points, then earlier index
validation_selection.training_to_validation_predictors: same P R.T + Q X.T, no refit on validation

acceptance: solver status 0 and success; LP requires no MIP gap. MIP additionally requires finite abs(primal-dual)<=1e-10 OR finite nonnegative relative gap<=1e-10. Numerical coefficient/support and reproduced-objective checks also apply.
bound_and_pruning: After a certified improving extension, if any channel weight >=.995*bound, multiply that channel bound by 2 and restart entire path from fixed initial family; at most 4 expansions. Remove only non-frozen atoms with both weights<=1e-9, and only if LP refit preserves objective within gain tolerance. Frozen leaf/RNJ supports are retained even at zero.
legacy_whitelist: outputs/mainline/metrics.json and docs/mainline_algorithm.md section 7 describe historical daily-demean/intercept/contracted finite RNJ pool; not current free-support mainline results.
source_hash_scope: All authoritative package Python files plus compatibility mainline entrypoint
fingerprint_capture: Fingerprints captured before new full-history driver / passive checkpoint edits; authoritative package at baseline commit 2be59701.

RX75_exact_formula.normalizers: s_R=max(mean({D_R[i,j]:D_R[i,j]>0}),1e-12), using 1 if the set is empty; s_X analogously
RX75_exact_formula.score_after_clipping: S_ij=max(S_ij,0), then min(S_ij,d_i,d_j); diagonal reset to d_i
RX75_exact_formula.interpretation: Separate channel normalization precedes 75/25 weighting; not R/X quotient or raw .75R+.25X.

bootstrap_exact_policy.resampling: within each scenario circular moving blocks, ceil(T/4) starts, concatenate then truncate to T; synchronously resample P,Q,Y
bootstrap_exact_policy.boundary_candidate: inclusion-minimal nontrivial clade in full-training RNJ tree
bootstrap_exact_policy.sort: descending frequency, descending block cardinality, ascending terminal-label tuple
bootstrap_exact_policy.selection: greedily select disjoint blocks, at most 2
bootstrap_exact_policy.fixed_supports: all singleton leaf edges, plus selected RNJ blocks for hybrid; retain supports even if coefficient becomes zero
bootstrap_exact_policy.failure_handling: original pipeline bootstrap has no per-replicate exception suppression; new driver must explicitly record failures and preserve 100 denominator if adding robust recording.

seed_difference_review.recommendation: Use pipeline seed 20260903 + training_replicate; this day has replicate 0 so use 20260903. Keep first-run 20261018 only in its frozen original protocol.
seed_difference_review.reason: A different seed changes resampled rows, RNJ stability frequencies and possibly the permanently fixed family. It is an extra policy change when the user requests complete current mainline.

authorized_64_32_adaptation.split_indices: New driver must record exact deterministic disjoint train/validation indices; do not infer them from the count alone.
authorized_64_32_adaptation.difference_from_mainline_default: User-authorized 64/32 split of one saved day replaces default 3x96 training plus independent 3x96 validation replicate.
authorized_64_32_adaptation.training_only_steps: FWL/regression, RNJ, bootstrap block selection, WZZT coefficient/support/source-path optimization must use only training rows.
authorized_64_32_adaptation.validation_only_steps: Evaluate each accepted fitted model using its training-estimated R/X and h/g, known validation source P/Q, then apply unchanged 1SE rule; do not refit on validation.
authorized_64_32_adaptation.solver_budget: Freeze any explicitly authorized caller override; mainline default is 1800 seconds per LP/MILP with no total-method wall cap.
authorized_64_32_adaptation.Source_extension: Mainline production fit/evaluator currently omit Source. New driver must propagate physical Source through every fixed fit, extension, pruning refit, accepted point, and validation prediction while preserving complete mainline policy.

score_policy_difference.production_mainline: All nontrivial result.support_labels are scored, including retained zero-weight fixed RNJ blocks; pipeline.py:342-346.
score_policy_difference.initial_AC96_benchmark: Only supports with max(r,x)>1e-8 are scored.
score_policy_difference.recommendation: Store both full-family mainline F1 and active-weight F1; explicitly freeze the primary score, and use the same score for any comparison. Neither threshold is the RNJ grouping tolerance.

mainline_not_lowlevel_default: Pipeline explicitly initializes all singleton atoms; low-level initial_supports=None means empty only for direct callers. Do not label the pipeline singleton policy as a deviation from mainline.

stop_reason_semantics.max_atoms: Forward accepted-iteration counter reaches caller max_atoms (default 2n-1).
stop_reason_semantics.no_feasible_extension: MILP status 2 reports no admissible extension.
stop_reason_semantics.no_significant_one_atom_gain_certified_b: An uncertified extension has a finite dual lower bound proving current objective minus bound <= gain tolerance.
stop_reason_semantics.extension_not_proven_optimal: Strict certificate failed and dual bound does not prove no significant gain; keep prior certified path.
stop_reason_semantics.extension_without_incumbent: Certified diagnostics but missing returned support/objective.
stop_reason_semantics.no_significant_one_atom_gain: Certified candidate training loss improvement <= abs_tol + rel_tol*max(abs(current_loss),epsilon).
stop_reason_semantics.bound_expansion_limit: Improving certified candidate touches finite bound after four allowed expansions.
stop_reason_semantics.repeated_family_after_zero_pruning: Pruning returns an already-seen support family.
stop_reason_semantics.exceptions: Validation, fixed LP, coefficient/support and numerical reproduction failures may raise; a runner must retain their records rather than turn them into successful stop reasons.

configuration_dataclasses: _CaseData and _RnjSelection hold internal case/selection records only. Public defaults reside in pipeline.run; CLI forwards explicit overrides only.
